cost_semantics.async: Positive integer backend extras over current source/scoped-work baseline; nonlinear actual counter replay required.
cost_semantics.l1_miss: Additional effective DATA-L1 miss response service; private hits unchanged. Accepted same-line actors keep their existing dependency order; no source NoC/probe queue equivalence claim.
cost_semantics.outer: Separately bound prior28 effective outer-return and shared launch services, not newly identified on this small source525 compute corpus.
cost_semantics.read_base: Charged by native conservative scalar DRAM reads and coherence fallbacks; integer private L1-hit load front bypasses it. Scalar FP load fallback also charges it. Not a physical L1 latency.
cost_semantics.vector_memory: Additional generic unitstride ATL load/store services; direct-L2 vector path retains zero L1D allocation and preserves outer transport reservation.
